Open a chapter and select a page image. Check that the preview contains the pages in reading order.
Open an episode and select the video. This step supports video/source elements with a direct address. Embedded players and protected streams may need the node editor.
Name a Home section, browse to the category you want, then select a card and its fields. Only this approved section will be added.
